target_customer: Remote teams, event organizers and communities wanting spatial video chat
problem: Video calls felt impersonal; users wanted proximity-based conversation and virtual spaces.
business_model: Freemium SaaS with paid spaces (not sourced)
product_category: Spatial video chat and virtual office platform

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time video, 2D world and proximity audio built by a small team; moderate engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Spatial video chat was copyable; network effects limited.

market_need_then: Pandemic remote work from 2020 drove demand; the product launched in May 2020 per YC page.

branding.domain_note: Gather.town domain (YC page URL); history not found

outcome_analysis: Gather launched in May 2020 into the pandemic remote-work surge and says it has raised $77M across Series A and B from Sequoia and Index among others. Individual round dates and amounts were not verified, and later traction is unknown from sources read, so the outcome is only partly assessed.
